name: Iori
message: 「Phew… I could’ve sworn she came this way…」
I followed Ririmu from the shopping area all the way to the station front. This station has a direct train line that goes to Osaka Metropolis.

name: Iori
message: 「Aha, found you, Ririmu！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Gyaaaah, you followed me all the way out here?！」
I grabbed the shoulder of Ririmu, who was trying to bolt again.

name: Iori
message: 「Gotcha. Now, we’re going back to the classroom…」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No, no, no! Help, I’m being kidnapped! Someone save me!」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, knock it off！ Don’t go shouting stuff like that at the top of your lungs！」
The area in front of the station was bustling with people, including not just students, but businessmen in suits and the elderly.
The icy glares from those innocent bystanders pierced right through me.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then let go of me~」

name: Iori
message: 「If I let go, you’ll just run away！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uh, obviously？」

name: Iori
message: 「Then I’m not letting go.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Kyaa！ Somebody！」

name: Iori
message: 「St-stop it, I said！」
I moved behind Ririmu, pinned her arms, and covered her mouth.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Mmph… mmmph-nggh, hnnngghhh！」
Ririmu struggled and thrashed about.

name: Iori
message: 「Heh heh heh, when it comes to pure physical strength, this teacher won’t lose！」
「…Excuse me, could you come with us for a moment?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes？」
I turned around to find people in blue uniforms standing there.
…They were officers from the local police station.

name: Police Officer
message: 「We received a report. Could we have a word with you？」

name: Iori
message: 「…And that’s the situation. I’m so sorry.」
I explained the situation to the police officer and lowered my head.

name: Police Officer
message: 「We understand the situation. You’re free to go.」

name: Police Officer
message: 「Just try not to do anything so confusing in public, okay?」

name: Iori
message: 「I am terribly sorry for the trouble！」
I bowed deeply again to the departing police officers.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Aha-ha-ha-ha, Sensei got chewed out by the cops~！」

name: Iori
message: 「...Who do you think's fault that is？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, scary face... Don't get so mad~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It was just a little joke, a joke」

name: Iori
message: 「You trying to kill me socially with your 'jokes'！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sorry~, but Sensei was being so pushy」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I just felt like getting a little help from the grownups♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Admittedly, my way of handling it wasn't the best either. I'll apologize for that.」

name: Iori
message: 「But that still doesn't excuse dragging the police into this...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You say it's trouble, but we just talked for a bit, right? I don't think it was that big a deal~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I know a bunch of cops, and they all seem happy to chat with me whenever I approach them？」

name: Iori
message: 「What kind of people are these police acquaintances of yours...？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「The people who came up to try and take me into custody when I ran away from home back then」
So she has that kind of history... That sounds exactly like her.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Police officers look like they have it all together, but on the inside, they're just human beings like the rest of us」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If you just talk to them, they're actually pretty understanding」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Some are super stiff and rigid like you, Sensei, and it's been annoying when they wouldn't bend the rules for me~」

name: Iori
message: 「My bad for not being flexible enough」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, look, I'm gonna do things my way. So don't worry about me so much, okay?」

name: Iori
message: 「...No, I can't do that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, first-year students at the academy have their midterm exams around the middle of June. Naturally, students in Takamura Class have to take them, too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, I know that much」

name: Iori
message: 「Then this will be quick.」
I project the data shared by Sasaki onto the HR.

name: Iori
message: 「This is the result of a quiz Ririmu took around the middle of April.」
Out of the written, performance, and practical portions, her score on the written exam was especially catastrophic.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa... my score is way too low.」

name: Iori
message: 「You’re one to talk.」
First-year students are given numerous quizzes to measure their ability, and to ensure they grasp their own level of proficiency.
They use those results to identify and shore up their weaknesses.

name: Iori
message: 「If you don't get a certain score on the midterm exams, you'll fail. Fail, and you'll have to take remedial classes followed by a make-up exam.」

name: Iori
message: 「Students who can't avoid failing that make-up exam will be held back.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, s-seriously！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, there are no safety nets. You're forcibly expelled.」

name: Iori
message: 「If your score on the April quiz is a true reflection of your current ability, you’ll almost certainly fail the midterm exam.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehh~！？ Does that mean it's possible for me to get kicked out before July？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah. It's not uncommon for students to get expelled within three months for failing to deliver results in the practical exams. Students who don't have the aptitude are weeded out and dropped one after another.」

name: Iori
message: 「Out of 200 freshmen, not even half will make it to graduation. That’s the kind of place Murakumo Academy is.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Th-that's bad！ You should've told me that from the start！」

name: Iori
message: 「Normally, your homeroom teacher explains that at the start, and it’s written in the enrollment documents, too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I didn't listen to the teacher, and why would I read those documents anyway！」
For God's sake, listen, and read them.

name: Iori
message: 「You've brought this on yourself.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehh~, Sensei, do something about it~」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course I plan to do something about it.」

name: Iori
message: 「But to do that, you first need to show up to class.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I don't wanna.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey！ Are you okay with getting expelled！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Besides, I saw my scores earlier, and my practical was super good, right? My form demonstration was pretty decent too, wasn't it?」
She's right—the only problem was the written exam.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then isn't that fine？ I mean, I'm in the Martial Arts Division, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Quite a few Martial Arts Division first-years flunk out because of the written exams, you know. Back when I was a student here, there were about ten of them.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That makes no sense！ Why does the Martial Arts Division even have written exams？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Martial artists don't need stuff like book learning！」

name: Iori
message: 「Just being a graduate of Murakumo Academy is a brand in itself. They probably want you to have the ability and education to match.」
Compared to other educational institutions, graduating from Murakumo Academy is pretty tough. That's precisely why its graduates are held in high regard and sought after everywhere.

name: Ririmu
message: 「No, come on—for a swordfighter, being strong is everything, right?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Who's the number one student in the Martial Arts Division？ Obviously the Toujinegi, right？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Can you become the Toujinegi by getting a good score on a written exam？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nope, you only get it by winning matches, right? You have to be strong.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No matter how brainy you are, if you can't win matches, nobody's gonna value you as a swordfighter, and nobody's gonna need you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well... that's true.」
The Martial Arts Division is just like athletics. Only people with the skill to deliver results are guaranteed favorable treatment.
If a swordfighter isn't strong, there's no point in the first place.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then shouldn't Martial Arts Division students be fine as long as they get good results in the practicals？ Why do you fail out just for not getting good scores on written exams？」
When she puts it like that, a half-baked teacher like me is left at a loss for words.

name: Ririmu
message: 「My last homeroom teacher kept telling me to study too, y'know, but I just couldn't accept it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, can you really get a proper education just from book learning？」
I can understand the doubts Ririmu feels, and how unfair it seems to her. All the more reason I'm struggling with how to answer.

name: Iori
message: 「You're surprisingly sharp, Ririmu.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh-heh! You're dead wrong if you thought I was an idiot!」

name: Iori
message: 「Then I feel like you could avoid failing grades if you just studied properly.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I told you before, Teach.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If I can't accept something, I don't do it and I won't do it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Why, because that’s my w-o-r-l-d-v-i-e-w, that’s why！」
Man, what a handful...

name: Ririmu
message: 「And with that, I’m off to the mainland~」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, hey, hold on a second！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way~！ Bye-bye-kin！」

name: Iori
message: 「Good grief, you never learn, do you...！」
I had no choice but to chase after her—and then.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa... ah, that was close！？」
Ririmu slammed on the brakes, having almost collided with someone walking from the station.
But as expected of the Martial Arts Division, she stopped just before impact. The person she almost hit appeared to be a martial artist as well, as they quickly pulled back and evaded Ririmu.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Wait, Momiji！？」
The person walking from the station was Momiji.

name: Momiji
message: 「I wondered who it was, and it’s Tobe-san... It’s dangerous to run like that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「My baaaad, I’ll be careful~」

name: Momiji
message: 「What are you in such a rush for... wait, Iori-sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「I hadn't seen you since this morning, so you were heading to the mainland?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes, that’s right.」
Momiji replied with a composed look on her face.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Must be nice~ I wanna go to the mainland too, but that Iorin over there keeps getting in my way, telling me to go to class~」

name: Momiji
message: 「I-Iorin？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yup, Muragaki Iori, so Iorin. Right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Iori-sensei, are you really going to let her call you that！？」

name: Iori
message: 「It sounds like Ririmu, so she can call me whatever she wants. But she’s still going to class.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way~！」

name: Iori
message: 「And for the record, that goes for you too, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’ve said it many times, but as a scholarship student, I am exempt from class. I am also permitted to go to the mainland during the day.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Seriously？ Lucky~ I wanna be a scholarship student too！」

name: Iori
message: 「Just so you know, Ririmu, honors students still have to take midterm exams, okay？」

name: Iori
message: 「And if you don't keep your scores higher than normal, your honors status gets revoked. If you get a failing grade, there's no makeup exam—you're expelled on the spot.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, on second thought, being a regular student works for me.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, Momicchi, did you score well on the written test for the last quiz？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Momicchi...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, Momicchi for Momiji. Momijiru sounds pretty good too~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Please go with Momicchi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, about the quiz.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Iorin's been grilling me over that quiz for a while now~」

name: Momiji
message: 「To be perfectly honest, I don't even understand the point of holding a test like that in the first place.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uh-huh, totally! I think so too.」

name: Iori
message: 「For the record, Momiji got a perfect 100 on every single subject on the written test except Japanese.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, seriously？！ Momicchi, you're super smart！」
Momiji's gripe with the test is probably something along the lines of not seeing why they have to bother checking stuff this easy.

name: Iori
message: 「You aced everything else, so why'd you lose points only on Japanese？」

name: Momiji
message: 「The model answers designated as correct by the grader contained arbitrary interpretations. Personally, I still cannot accept their grading method.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, I feel that! Japanese tests make zero sense~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Like, 'Explain the author's feelings'? How am I supposed to know that?」

name: Iori
message: 「Hate to interrupt your bonding moment, Ririmu, but your problem starts way before that. You can't even write kanji properly in the first place.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Shut up, shut up! Stop only dissing me!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I wish midterm exams would just disappear！」

name: Momiji
message: 「As long as I produce results on the midterms, I can maintain my honors student status, so it would be rather troublesome for me if they were abolished.」
She's right—for an honors student, test results are everything.
Only by proving through sheer ability that you are far superior to the other students are you granted the privilege of class exemption.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, by the way, Momicchi, there's something I've been wondering about.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That duffel bag looks heavy. What’s in it？」
Momiji is carrying a large bag over her shoulder. Judging by how deeply the strap is digging into her shoulder, it seems to have some weight to it, but...

name: Momiji
message: 「I just did a bit of shopping on the mainland.」

name: Iori
message: 「What did you buy？」
If she bought a mountain of high-calorie snacks, I’d have to scold her as an athlete, that’s for sure.

name: Momiji
message: 「There’s nothing strange in there, really.」
……Hmm, I’m suspicious.
Asahi said it too, didn’t she? That Momiji will use any means necessary to get her own way.

name: Iori
message: 「Then why don’t you let me see what’s inside?」

name: Iori
message: 「If it’s nothing strange, that shouldn’t be a problem, right？」
I cast a gaze at her that brooks no argument, pressing Momiji for an answer. If she panics, it means she’s definitely hiding something.
Alright, Momiji, what’s your move？

name: Momiji
message: 「……Do you really want to see inside that badly？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I do.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Really？」

name: Iori
message: 「There’s no need to hide it, is there？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why are you so interested in my personal belongings?」

name: Iori
message: 「Because you’re my student, Momiji.」
This is getting even more suspicious. What is she hesitating so much about？

name: Momiji
message: 「*Sigh*………… Alright, fine.」
As if resigned, Momiji unzipped the duffel bag and pulled out a small bundle.

name: Momiji
message: 「Go ahead, please check the contents.」
When I was told to open it and did so, what came out was… a tiny piece of cloth.
To put it bluntly, it was underwear.

name: Iori
message: 「Wh-what the…！」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s the underwear and undergarments I bought on the mainland. There are also some spare socks and towels; would you like to check those too？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, I get it, I totally get it. You can’t really find any decent clothes or underwear unless you go to the mainland~」
What was inside were pure white panties and a bra, with very little decoration. It was a simple yet elegant design.

name: Momiji
message: 「Please don't stare at it so closely. It's embarrassing.」

name: Iori
message: 「S-Sorry, I didn't know it was underwear！」
I hurriedly handed the bundle back to Momiji.

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, you noticed I didn't want you to, didn't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, yeah...」
That's precisely why I thought it was suspicious, though.

name: Momiji
message: 「In that case, I wish you had shown a little more consideration.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You've got no tact at all, Iori~n.」

name: Iori
message: 「Sorry, you're right...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I hear this is your first time teaching girls' academy students, Iori-sensei, and I think the misleading way I acted was part of the problem too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Let's both try to be more considerate of each other from now on.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I'll be careful.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Please don't worry about it. Well then, I'll excuse myself now.」
With her duffel bag in one hand, Momiji headed off toward the academy.
